title: ZCode app-server wire vocabulary
description: Every table is a map from the identifier both languages spell (PascalCase, so the Go constant and the TS key derive from one name) to the literal the app-server sends. A table may never be empty: an empty one would emit an enum no dispatch can match, and the generator's own coverage check would have nothing to compare.

defaultMode.description: The key in `modes` a fresh ZCode session runs on. A key, not a literal, so it cannot name a mode the table does not carry -- the generator checks the membership.
